evidence.reason: The test claims to cover compatibility checks before hold, after drain, and after switch, but lines 236-237 only record the SHA passed to compatibility_record and assert there are at least three calls, all using the prior SHA. They never observe the drain/switch boundaries, so three pre-switch calls would satisfy the assertions even if no post-switch compatibility check occurred. This is a routine test-correctness gap in the test's stated behavior; record each call's phase and require a prior-SHA check in each phase.
